name: SearchWeb
title: Search Web
description: Search the web using SearchAPI.io (Google) for web results and images
whenToUse: Pick to find WEB PAGES and images for a keyword query: titles, URLs and snippets from across the open web (Google). Use it for general open-web results, any relevant page; it returns web pages, not specifically dated news, videos, places, or social posts.

package.name: search
package.packageFile:
$schema: ../_schema/package.schema.json

# FULLY DECLARATIVE. Four nodes, one endpoint, one key.
#
# SearchAPI.io is the cleanest case for this format: every engine is the SAME url switched
# by `engine=`, authenticated by one `api_key` in the query. `shared/searchapi.yaml` holds
# the call, each node names its engine and shapes its own reply, and the whole client is
# gone: `auth: apiKeyQuery` was already an executor capability.
#
# The retired TypeScript is at `_legacy/nodes/search/`.

name: search
displayName: Search
description: Web, news, video and places search via SearchAPI.io
version: 2.0.0
category: search
logoUrl: https://cdn-icons-png.flaticon.com/512/3128/3128287.png

features:
  - Google web and image results
  - Google News, dated articles
  - YouTube video search
  - Google Maps places with ratings

allowedHosts:
  - www.searchapi.io

requires:
  credential: [apiKeyQuery]
  transport: [json]
  executorVersion: ">=1.0.0"

credentials.searchapiCredential.yaml:
$schema: ../../_schema/credential.schema.json

# One key powers every engine in this package. Transcribed from src/credentials/index.ts.

name: searchapiCredential
displayName: SearchAPI
description: SearchAPI.io credentials. One key powers every search engine in this package.
documentationUrl: https://www.searchapi.io/docs

properties:
  - name: apiKey
    displayName: API Key
    type: string
    required: true
    secret: true
    description: Your SearchAPI.io API key
    placeholder: ""

shared.searchapi.yaml:
# The ONE call every node in this package makes.
#
# Same url, same auth, switched by `engine`. A node $refs this and layers its own `query`
# keys on top, which is what a $ref with siblings does: imported first, local wins.
#
# The key travels as a query parameter because that is what the vendor takes. `apiKeyQuery`
# is an executor capability, so no node handles a secret itself.

call: &call
  method: GET
  url: https://www.searchapi.io/api/v1/search
  credential:
    scheme: apiKeyQuery
    param: api_key
    value: "{{ credentials.searchapiCredential.apiKey }}"
  headers:
    Accept: application/json
  transport: json
  retry:
    attempts: 3
    backoff: exponential
    on: [429, 500, 502, 503, 504]

# A 200 is not always a success here: the vendor reports a bad parameter or an exhausted
# quota in the body. Without this a failed search emits empty results and reads as "nothing
# found", which is the wrong answer rather than an error.
error: &error
  when: "return !!response.error"
  message: "return typeof response.error === 'string' ? response.error : JSON.stringify(response.error)"

files.api/events.yaml:
# One row per output connector, in interface.yaml order.
#
# Both read `calls.<name>`, because the image pass is conditional: when it is skipped there
# is no key, and `imageResults` is correctly empty rather than undefined.

- emit: webResults
  from: response
  value: >-
    return (((calls.web || {}).organic_results) || []).map(r => ({
      title: r.title || "",
      url: r.link || "",
      source: r.source || "",
      snippet: r.snippet || ""
    }))

- emit: imageResults
  from: response
  # A `data:` thumbnail is dropped, matching SearchNews. Measured clean on this engine today (0 of
  # 100 results base64), so this guards a REGRESSION rather than fixing a live fault: it means an
  # engine swap cannot put inline base64 onto the wire the way `google_news` did. Dropped rather than
  # truncated — a cut-off data URI is a corrupt image a renderer still tries to display.
  value: >-
    return (((calls.images || {}).images) || []).slice(0, config.numImages).map(i => ({
      url: (i.original || {}).link || i.link || "",
      title: i.title || "",
      thumbnail: (i.thumbnail || "").startsWith("data:") ? "" : i.thumbnail || "",
      source_url: (i.source || {}).link || "",
      source_name: (i.source || {}).name || ""
    }))
files.api/run.yaml:
# Two calls: the web search, then a dedicated image pass when it is switched on. Two
# separate engines, which is why this is a list rather than one request.

- $ref: searchapi#call
  name: web
  error: { $ref: searchapi#error }
  query:
    engine: google
    q: "{{ config.query }}"
    num: "{{ config.numResults }}"
    gl: "{{ config.country }}"
    hl: "{{ config.language }}"
    # Anything not "off" is coerced to "active", so a workflow saved with the long-removed
    # "moderate" keeps working instead of failing every search.
    safe: "return config.safeSearch === 'off' ? 'off' : 'active'"

- $ref: searchapi#call
  name: images
  when: "return config.searchImages === true && config.numImages > 0"
  error: { $ref: searchapi#error }
  query:
    engine: google_images
    q: "{{ config.query }}"
    num: "{{ config.numImages }}"
    safe: "return config.safeSearch === 'off' ? 'off' : 'active'"
    size: large
files.config.yaml:
$schema: ../../../_schema/config.schema.json

configSchema:
  type: object
  required: [query]
  properties:
    query:
      type: string
      title: Search Query
      description: Query to search for
      default: ""
      "ui:field": template
    numResults:
      type: number
      title: Number of Results
      description: Number of web results to return
      default: 20
      minimum: 1
      maximum: 100
    searchImages:
      type: boolean
      title: Search Images
      description: Whether to also run a dedicated image search
      default: true
      "ui:widget": toggle
    numImages:
      type: number
      title: Number of Images
      description: Number of image results to return
      default: 10
      minimum: 0
      maximum: 50
      "ui:dependencies": { searchImages: true }
    safeSearch:
      type: string
      title: Safe Search
      # The vendor's google `safe` param takes ONLY these two. "moderate" was offered here
      # once and returned HTTP 400 on every search.
      enum: [active, off]
      enumNames: [Active, Off]
      default: active
    country:
      type: string
      title: Country
      description: Country code for localized results, e.g. 'us', 'uk', 'ae'
      default: us
    language:
      type: string
      title: Language
      description: Language code for results, e.g. 'en', 'ar'
      default: en

    # WHO MAY RUN THIS BOX, set by whoever builds the workflow (15-who-can-run-it.md).
    #
    # INSTANCE config, not the manifest's `auth`, and the two answer different questions.
    # The manifest is the node author's FLOOR: "this node is inherently privileged". These
    # are the builder's, per box on the canvas, because the same node type legitimately
    # faces staff on one workflow and customers on another.
    #
    # A role especially has to live here: `finance:approve` is a claim THIS deployment's
    # identity provider mints, and a node published to the marketplace cannot know the role
    # vocabulary of every universe that installs it.
    #
    # The executor takes the STRICTER of the two. Neither can loosen the other.
    authRequired:
      type: boolean
      title: Require sign-in
      description: Only signed-in callers can run this step.
      default: false
      "ui:widget": toggle
    authRole:
      type: string
      title: Require role
      description: A claim the caller must carry, like finance:approve.
      default: ""
      "ui:dependencies": { authRequired: true }

"ui:order":
  [authRequired, authRole, query, numResults, searchImages, numImages, safeSearch, country, language]
files.interface.yaml:
$schema: ../../../_schema/interface.schema.json

inputs:
  - name: query
    type: string
    description: Search query
    required: false

outputs:
  - name: webResults
    type: array
    description: Web search results (title, url, source, snippet)
  - name: imageResults
    type: array
    description: Image results (url, title, thumbnail, source). Empty when image search is off.

credentials:
  - name: searchapiCredential
    required: true
    displayName: SearchAPI
files.node.yaml:
$schema: ../../../_schema/node.schema.json

type: SearchWeb
kind: PromiseNode
name: Search Web
category: Search
color: "#4285F4"
description: Search the web using SearchAPI.io (Google) for web results and images
whenToUse: >
  Pick to find WEB PAGES and images for a keyword query: titles, URLs and snippets from
  across the open web (Google). Use it for general open-web results, any relevant page; it
  returns web pages, not specifically dated news, videos, places, or social posts.

# WHO MAY RUN THIS (DECLARATIVE_NODES.md §9.13). Compulsory on every node, so that a node
# nobody thought about cannot look the same as one deliberately left open.
#
# `required: false` adds no requirement of its own: the node runs for whoever the trigger
# admitted. The trigger instance's publicEntry toggle still owns the door, and requirements
# only ever narrow.
auth:
  required: false

capabilities:
  # Idempotent read: the same query yields the same results, so a prior output may be
  # reused instead of re-running the search (EXECUTION_EFFICIENCY.md §3.2).
  cacheable: true
files.test.yaml:
$schema: ../../../_schema/test.schema.json

testData:
  config:
    query: AI regulation
    numResults: 20
    numImages: 10
    searchImages: true
    safeSearch: active
    country: us
    language: en
  inputs:
    query: AI regulation
  expect:
    webResults: "return output.webResults.length > 0 && typeof output.webResults[0].url === 'string'"
    # searchImages is ON in this fixture, so an EMPTY array is a failure, not a pass.
    # `Array.isArray` alone would have gone green with the image call never firing.
    imageResults: "return output.imageResults.length > 0 && typeof output.imageResults[0].url === 'string'"
